notes:
SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.83

Funds collected reads QuickBooks much faster. It asks only for the fields the report uses. What it read is kept for 10 minutes, so changing a filter or grouping, or exporting, doesn’t read QuickBooks again. Use Read QuickBooks again to refresh.
Settings shows where the app is installed: the server’s computer name, the address users open, the data folder, and whether the QuickBooks helper is running.
